// about.md

About

Data science, machine learning and AI, with a habit of explaining all three.

about.mdmarkdown

I started in customer service and asked for an internship. Now I build the machine learning that decides what millions of people see next.

I'm the first in my family to go to university, so I know what tech looks like from the outside. That's why I explain AI with stories, not jargon. My first blog post explains recommender systems with a girl in a green scarf.

My first talk felt like a disaster. I kept saying yes anyway, and that took me to ICML in Seoul and a stage at Big Data London.

I like building things people actually use, whether that's a model in production or a little focus timer for students.

off the laptop beginner figure skater · archer · finally made it to RecSys karaoke

// projects/

Projects

Production ML, evaluation, NLP and things I've built with AI.

offline-evaluation/team standard

Offline evaluation framework

A Python library that predicts how a model change will perform before it reaches an A/B test, using ranking metrics such as NDCG, precision, recall and coverage. It became my team's standard evaluation process, and I presented the approach at ICML.

def ndcg_at_k(ranked, relevant, k): # DCG@k / IDCG@k
Pythonevaluationexperimentation
thecompanion/● live

thecompanion: focus timer

A free iOS focus timer that turns a to-do list into Pomodoro sessions, with a small companion beside you. I designed it, built it with help from Claude Code, and shaped it with a student community on Reddit. No accounts, no data collected.

iOSClaude CodeApp Store ↗
realtime-ml/production

Batch to real-time inference

batch jobs→real-time API

Led the data science side of moving a two-tower model to real-time, API-driven inference for more than 12 million customers.

AWSDockerCI/CD
ai-workflows/ongoing

Building with LLMs

Python scripts that call LLM APIs, low-code automations, and a prompt library other people reuse.

LLM APIsprompt engineering
similar-items/production

Similar items with NLP

A content-based model that finds similar products from text metadata alone, so new items can be recommended straight away.

PythonTF-IDFWord2Vec
bookclub/early stage

bookclub

Book recommendations from reading personas like The Night Owl and The Vibe Chaser, using mood, pace, themes and writing style as well as genre, with a community for live bookclubs.
